slides.label: Verse 1
lines: Your Word is yes and amen, It’s unbreakable
From knowing You
We’ve become models to the world

slides.label: Verse 2
lines: Our fathers told us of all You did in their day
Greater is seen today through us, My Lord King

slides.label: Verse 3
lines: The life of shame, the life of dread and
uncertainty ended when You came to men
God in flesh, Our life of perfection started with You

slides.label: Verse 4
lines: What the law brought to men was sin and death
And it ended when You
Showed us how to live Your truth
Our life of eternity started in You

slides.label: Verse 5
lines: You stilled the stormy sea
You’re the Prince of peace
That’s why, when we pray, in Your name, wars cease
You are the blessed One king David called his Lord
You existed before Your birth great God, My Lord King
